name: Delaware State Fair
blurb: Ten days at the Harrington fairgrounds at the turn of July into August. Livestock, 4-H, grandstand concerts and rides. It's the largest annual event in the state and it fills Kent County accommodation for the duration.

rule.hint: Late July into early August — the fair publishes dates a year at a time and states no recurring rule

admission.note: Admission and parking are charged; the amounts are not stated on the fair's own front page and are not confirmed here.

warnings: Grandstand concerts are ticketed separately from fair admission.

sources.label: Delaware State Fair: official site
sources.note: States "JULY 23 - August 1, 2026" and the fairgrounds address. Publishes no recurring rule, so future years are not computed.

sources.label: Coordinates
sources.note: Location only, not a fact about the event. Nominatim, the fairgrounds themselves.

outstanding: PRIORITY: get gate admission and parking prices, and whether any day is discounted.

name: Sea Witch Festival
venue: Downtown Rehoboth Beach and the boardwalk
blurb: Rehoboth's Halloween weekend, with a costume parade, fiddlers, and the town at its busiest outside high summer. It lands after the beach dog ban lifts on 16 September, which makes it one of the few big weekends where dogs are legal on the sand.

rule.hint: Late October — the Chamber publishes dates a year at a time and states no recurring rule

admission.note: The festival is free to attend; individual events within it may be ticketed. Not confirmed.

website.label: Sea Witch Festival: Rehoboth Beach-Dewey Beach Chamber of Commerce

warnings: Rehoboth's beach and boardwalk dog ban runs 15 May to 15 September, so dogs are legal by late October — but check the town page before relying on it.
The full program is not published until early October, so a detailed schedule this far out will be last year's.

sources.label: Sea Witch Festival: Rehoboth Beach-Dewey Beach Chamber of Commerce
sources.note: The organizing Chamber. Gives 23–25 October 2026 and states that programs are mailed in early October, so no rule is published.

name: Arden Fair
venue: The Arden Club and the village greens
blurb: A one-day craft and antiques fair on the greens at Arden, run by the Arden Club, and in 2026 it's the 118th one. Bagpipes open it at 9:50 in the morning and close it at 6. In between there are over a hundred craft vendors, an antiques market, used books inside Gild Hall, live music in the Shady Grove, and games and rides for children. Getting in is free. What you can't do is park in the village, so plan on the shuttle.

admission.note: Free at the gate. The vendors, the food and the rides are what you actually spend money on.

warnings: There is no parking in the village. Free shuttle buses run from the YMCA Hanby Outdoor Center on Chestnut Road, between Marsh and Darley Roads, just north of Arden.

sources.label: The Arden Club: Arden Fair
sources.note: The organizer's own page, read 8 August 2026. States "Every year the Arden Fair and Antiques Market is held on the Saturday of Labor Day Weekend", gives Saturday 5 September 2026 as the 118th fair, free admission, opening bagpipes at 9:50 a.m. and closing at 6 p.m., and the Hanby Outdoor Center shuttle.

sources.label: Coordinates
sources.note: Location only, not a fact about the event. Nominatim, the Arden Club.

outstanding: Ring the club to confirm the shuttle runs the whole day, and where it puts you down.
Ask whether the antiques market keeps the same hours as the rest of the fair.
The club states the rule but the site should still check the club's calendar each year, in case a year is moved.

name: Old-Fashioned Ice Cream Festival
blurb: New Castle County's ice cream festival on the lawn at Rockwood, one afternoon and evening in late June that runs to fireworks at dusk. Ice cream vendors, food trucks, a festival train, carnival games, inflatables, a kids' DJ, an entertainment stage and tours of the house. Five dollars to get in, and children 12 and under come free with a paying adult. Nobody parks at the park — the county shuttles everyone in.

rule.hint: Late June — the county announces one date at a time and states no recurring rule

admission.note: $5 at the gate. Children 12 and under are free with a paying adult.

website.label: New Castle County: Ice Cream Festival at Rockwood Park

warnings: There is no on-site parking at Rockwood Park. Free shuttles run throughout the event from Rockwood Office Park at 501 Carr Road, including handicap-accessible buses, and overflow parking opens at Mt. Pleasant High School when it's needed.
The 2026 festival has already happened. The county has not yet announced a 2027 date, so nothing on this page tells you when to go next year.

sources.note: The county's own release, read 8 August 2026. Free shuttle service will operate throughout the event from Rockwood Office Park, 501 Carr Road".

name: Brandywine Festival of the Arts
blurb: Two days of juried art under the trees in Brandywine Park, the weekend after Labor Day, and it has been running for well over half a century. Over 200 artists. Five dollars a day to get in, cash or Venmo. Park at Incyte on Augustine Cut Off and take the shuttle, which is the rare one that will carry your dog.

admission.note: $5 a day, cash or Venmo. The festival doesn't say on its own site whether children get in free, so this page doesn't either.

warnings: Free shuttle buses run to the festival entrance from Incyte, 1815 Augustine Cut Off. The festival states the shuttles are pet friendly, "for friendly pets".
Only a very limited number of accessible spaces are on the park grounds themselves, and the festival asks you to show a placard to the police officers at the entrances.
